item.text: I’m checking whether the 2024 record shows broad distribution through reconstruction, MSME finance, and social relief versus favoritism or politically selective treatment. After that I’ll stop searching and synthesize only the strongest claim-level items.

item.text:
Mixed, leaning negative. Erdoğan’s 2024 economic record includes real inclusive channels for women, youth, MSMEs, and earthquake-hit areas, but there is also strong evidence of targeted relief, regional property-rights shocks, and broader group favoritism that undercuts fair distribution.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Republic of Türkiye: 2024 Article IV Consultation-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for the Republic of Türkiye | IMF | 2024-10-11 | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/11/republic-of-trkiye-2024-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-556139 | IMF said tax and expenditure measures should protect earthquake-related spending and vulnerable households, and that harmonizing VAT and improving compliance would support fairness in taxation. This is evidence that the policy framework at least explicitly considered distributional fairness. | 5B.8, 5B.3, 5B.7 |
| Positive | Turkiye: 2024 Article IV Mission Press Release | IMF | 2024-08-28 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/08/28/pr24311-turkiye-2024-article-iv-mission-press-release | IMF said the policy turnaround reduced crisis risks and urged reforms to reduce SME burdens, simplify approvals, cut tax/compliance costs, and improve labor-market functioning. That supports a more inclusive, broad-base growth model rather than a narrow patronage model. | 5B.8, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.7 |
| Positive | World Bank to Support Women, Youth Owned Small Businesses and Industry Adapt to Green Transition in Türkiye | World Bank | 2024-04-01 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/03/29/world-bank-to-support-women-youth-owned-small-businesses-and-industry-adapt-to-green-transition-in-turkiye | The World Bank said $400 million would help women and youth access jobs and finance in the green transition, with support targeted to women- and youth-led MSMEs and less developed areas. This is direct evidence of gains being directed beyond the regime base. | 5B.8, 5B.6, 5B.4 |
| Positive | Türkiye - Socially Inclusive Green Transition Project | World Bank | 2024-03-06 | https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099031124170520652 | The project’s objective is to improve women and youth economic opportunities and support inclusive and green investments, local infrastructure, and MSME finance. This is one of the clearest 2024 examples of explicit fairness-oriented economic distribution. | 5B.8, 5B.6, 5B.4 |
| Positive | Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake | Reuters | 2024-02-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916 | Erdoğan’s government handed over 7,275 homes in Hatay and promised more reconstruction. This is real regional redistribution toward a disaster-hit province, though still partial and delayed. | 5B.8, 5B.6, 5B.3 |
| Negative | Shock and confusion as Turkey seizes earthquake survivors' homes | Reuters | 2024-03-18 | https://www.reuters.com/commodities/shock-confusion-turkey-seizes-earthquake-survivors-homes-2024-03-18/ | Reuters reported deeds in Hatay being transferred to the Treasury under an urban-planning amendment, alarming survivors. This is a direct region-specific property-rights and distribution failure, especially harmful to displaced households. | 5B.8, 5B.4, 5B.6, 5B.3 |
| Negative | Turkey to lift minimum retirement pay, impose minimum corporate tax | Reuters | 2024-07-16 | https://theprint.in/world/turkey-to-lift-minimum-retirement-pay-impose-minimum-corporate-tax/2176793/ | The package looks like targeted relief and political management rather than a broad redistribution strategy. It helps lower-income retirees, but the narrowness suggests selective class management rather than durable fairness. | 5B.8, 5B.7, 5B.3 |
| Negative | Turkey - Freedom in the World 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says AKP politics favored Sunni Muslims, Kurdish parties faced harassment, women and LGBT people remained politically marginalized, and refugees faced severe restrictions and anti-foreigner rhetoric. This is direct evidence against fair distribution across groups. | 5B.8, 5B.7, 4B.7 |
| Negative | Türkiye: Government Removes Elected Opposition Mayors | Human Rights Watch | 2024-11-07 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors | HRW says elected opposition mayors were removed and councils dissolved, with appointees replacing them after local election wins. That indicates politically selective treatment of opposition-held regions rather than even-handed distribution of state benefits and authority. | 5B.8, 4B.10, 5B.4 |

Search gap: I did not find a single 2024 source that directly measures distribution of economic gains by region, class, gender, and regime support in one dataset. The evidence is indirect but consistent: there are real inclusive programs for women, youth, MSMEs, and earthquake survivors, yet the broader pattern still includes selective relief, property-rights shocks in opposition-leaning regions, and group favoritism.
